 Manager Global SAP Applications.
   

  

 While the preferred location for this role is Solna, the position can also be based in one of our mills in Sweden. Frequent travel to our Solna office is an essential part of the role.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.


  

  

* Documented experience working with SAP Security and Authorizations.


  

  

* Deep understanding of SAP authorization concepts, role design, and access governance.


  

  

* Experience supporting audits, compliance activities, and regulatory requirements.


  

  

* Good understanding of Segregation of Duties (SoD), risk management, and internal controls.


  

  

  

  

* Experience with SAP Identity Access Governance (IAG), SAP GRC, or similar governance tools is considered highly beneficial.


  

  

* Knowledge of identity integrations involving SAP solutions, Azure AD, IAS/IPS, or enterprise IAM platforms.


  

  

* Understanding of SAP licensing principles and how role design impacts license allocation is an advantage.


  

  

* SAP Security or SAP GRC certifications are considered beneficial.


  

  

* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.


  

  

 Note: You need to have a permanent Swedish work permit to be considered for this position
   

  

 Personal qualities
   

  

 You are an analytical and detail-oriented professional with a strong interest in security, governance, and risk management. You enjoy solving complex challenges and balancing security requirements with business needs.
   

  

 You collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries and communicate confidently with both technical specialists and business stakeholders. With a structured and proactive approach, you build trust, drive improvements, and contribute to sustainable and compliant solutions.
   

  

 As a team player, you thrive in an international environment and are committed to delivering high-quality results that support both operational excellence and long-term business goals.
   

  

 Our values are central to our business, and we believe you recognize yourself in: We care for each other and We do what we say!
   

  

 Contact
   

  

 If you have any questions, don't hesitate to reach out to Katarina Kopkin, Senior Manager Global Applicants; katarina.kopkin@billerud.com or if you have any questions regarding the recruitment, please contact Mimmi Jonsson, Sr TAP; mimmi.jonsson@billerud.com
   

  

 Application information
   

  

 Selection and interviews will be held on an ongoing basis. Please apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 Click here to apply for the job!
   

  

 Do you want to help create a sustainable future through your work?
   

  

 At Billerud, we are fully committed to reduce our and our customers carbon footprint by offering high-performance paper and packaging materials. We are convinced that the right solutions can be important tools to help fight climate change. That's why we see it as our responsibility to enable the best packaging choices, for a better tomorrow.
   

  

 Our proud history in the forestry and paper industry goes back more than 150 years. Since then, we’ve grown to what we are today: a world leading company in high-performing paper and packaging materials - passionately committed to sustainability, quality, and customer value. Our materials are the basis of packaging and paper products used by millions of people around the world, 24 hours a day, all year round.
   

  

 We serve customers in more than 100 countries through our three business areas Liquid Packaging Board, Paper and Paper Board. Our nine production units are located in Sweden, USA, and Finland and we have around 5,200 employees in 16 countries. Our annual turnover is approximately SEK 40.5 billion and the share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. At Billerud we always put safety first, care for each other, and do what we say.
   

  

 Join us in redefining sustainable packaging and drive meaningful change for a better tomorrow.

title: Senior Nätverksspecialist med projektledarkompetens till MUST
description:
**Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete och bidra till ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld?**
 Vi söker nu erfaren medarbetare som vill arbeta med teknisk projektledning, nät-arkitektur, design, utveckling och omsättningsprojekt av Försvarsmaktens IT-infrastruktur inom den Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must). Fokus kommer bland annat ligga på produktion och vidareutveckling av säkra IT-lösningar. Tillsammans med sektionen, bidrar du till att en effektiv informationshantering, såväl kortsiktigt som långsiktigt.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
 Du kommer huvudsakligen att arbeta med frågor inom nätverks-arkitektur, design och vidareutveckling av säkra kommunikationslösningar och nätverksinfrastrukturer. I arbetet ingår planering, dokumentation, projektledning, till del viss konfiguration och stöd till förvaltning och driftorganisationen. Arbetet är omväxlande och för att lyckas i din roll arbetar du tillsammans kollegor och beredd att även hantera ”Hands On”, högt som lågt. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår att delta och ge stöd till kontorets övriga verksamhet. Beredskapstjänstgöring och resor kan förekomma. Vi erbjuder ett meningsfullt arbete där du dagligen bidrar till en ökad säkerhet åt Sverige, totalförsvaret och Försvarsmakten. Genom kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling får du även goda möjligheter att utveckla dig själv och dina kunskaper.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Våra medarbetare har olika bakgrund men med ett gemensamt intresse och kunskap inom nätverksteknik. Du är lösningsorienterad, proaktiv, prestigelös, nyfiken, driven och uppskattar att både självständigt och i samarbete med andra anta utmaningar, förmedla och omsätta idéer till slutlig produkt. Det är också viktigt att vara flexibel för att kunna hantera förändrade förutsättningar. Som person är du även trygg i dig själv, med stor integritet och ett naturligt säkerhetsmedvetande. Du är nyfiken, kreativ och kan uppnå ett stort förtroende hos såväl interna som externa kunder och uppdragsgivare.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
* Akademisk/eftergymnasial utbildning med inriktning mot nätverk och datakommunikation, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande kunskaper som av arbetsgivaren bedömmer likvärdigt
* Flerårig relevant yrkeserfarenhet
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift.


**Meriterande**
* Kunskaper inom informations-/ IT-säkerhet
* Certifieringar inom CISCO produkter
* Djup förståelse för funktion och konfiguration av routrar, switchar, brandväggar
* Teknisk projektledning
* Erfarenhet av IT-infrastruktur från Försvarsmakten eller annan myndighet inom totalförsvaret.


**Övrigt**
 Anställningsform: Tillsvidare
   

  

 Sysselsättningsgrad: 100%, heltid
   

  

 Arbetsort: Stockholm, på plats med mycket liten/ingen möjlighet att jobba hemifrån
   

  

 Tillträdesdatum: Enligt överenskommelse
   

  

**För upplysningar om befattningen eller rekryteringsprocessen kontakta:**
 hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se, vänligen skriv ”Nätverksspecialist KT” i ämnesraden.
   

  

**Fackliga företrädare**
 Fackliga representanter nås via hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se.
   

  

**Sista ansökningsdag**
*Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-09-30, vi tillämpar löpande urval så inkom gärna med din ansökan så snart som möjligt. I ditt CV och personliga brev vill vi att du beskriver på vilket sätt du uppfyller våra efterfrågade krav och meriter. Du ansöker via* 
*jobb.forsvarsmakten.se.*
 ,
 **Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats.** 
 -------------------------------------------------------- Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) är en del av Försvarsmaktens högkvarter i Stockholm. Vi ger regeringen och Försvarsmakten kvalificerade beslutsunderlag om omvärldsutvecklingen och hot mot Sveriges och Försvarsmaktens säkerhet. Vår vision är ”Ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld”. Must är en kunskapsorganisation och erbjuder både spännande och för Sverige angelägna arbetsuppgifter. Här arbetar både officerare och civila experter inom olika områden, t ex statsvetenskap, IT, ekonomi, teknik, matematik och HR. En stor del av Must verksamhet omfattas av sekretess och vi ber dig därför att inte berätta att du sökt jobb hos Must för andra personer än dina närmaste. Läs gärna mer om Must och vår verksamhet här Varje dag och varje timme gör våra medarbetare insatser som påverkar andra människors liv, både i stort och smått, och både på hemmaplan och runt om i världen. Försvarsmakten ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas som människa och växa i din professionella roll. Vi är en ansvarstagande arbetsgivare och har en öppen organisation där vi ställer upp för varandra. I Försvarsmakten finns en stark värdegrund som bygger på öppenhet, resultat och ansvar. Professionell utveckling och personlig hälsa värdesätts och uppmuntras. Det finns goda förutsättningar för intern karriärrörlighet, friskvård och bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Försvarsmakten tillvaratar de kvaliteter som mångfald och jämn könsfördelning tillför verksamheten. Vi välkomnar därför sökanden med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter i våra rekryteringar. En anställning hos oss innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. I anställningen ingår även en skyldighet att tjänstgöra utomlands. Innebörden av detta varierar beroende på typ av befattning. Till ansökan om anställning ska CV och personligt brev bifogas. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid vidimerade kopior av betyg och intyg uppvisas. Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

title: 🎨 Senior UX-designer – komplexa interna verktyg & designsystem
description:
Är du en erfaren UX-designer som trivs med att göra komplexa system enkla, intuitiva och effektiva för användaren? Vi söker nu en senior UX-designer till ett längre konsultuppdrag i Stockholm, där du får arbeta nära både användare, produktägare och utvecklare i två tvärfunktionella agila team.
  
Du kommer att arbeta med verksamhetskritiska interna verktyg som används dagligen av redaktionell personal. Det handlar bland annat om arkiv, sökverktyg och andra digitala lösningar som ska göra användarnas arbetsflöden enklare och mer effektiva.
  
Om uppdraget
  
Som UX-designer får du ett brett ansvar för hela designprocessen – från att förstå användarnas behov till färdig design.
  
  

**Du kommer bland annat att:**  

Planera och genomföra research och användartester
  
  

Förstå komplexa arbetsflöden och identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter
  
  

Facilitera workshops och driva konceptutveckling
  
  

Ta fram design och komponenter i Figma
  
  

️ Bidra till utvecklingen av ett gemensamt internt designsystem
  
  

Arbeta tätt tillsammans med produktägare, utvecklare och andra UX-designers
  
  

Utvärdera och förbättra lösningar iterativt tillsammans med användare och team
  
  

Du kommer att fördela din tid mellan två agila team. Hur fördelningen ser ut planeras tillsammans med respektive produktägare, och det förekommer även samarbete mellan team och andra delar av organisationen.
  
En viktig del av rollen är att kunna avgöra vilken UX-metod som passar bäst i respektive fas – och att kunna omsätta research och komplexa behov till genomtänkta, hållbara lösningar.
  
Vem söker vi?
  
Vi söker dig som är trygg i din UX-kompetens och van vid att självständigt driva designarbete samtidigt som du uppskattar nära samarbete med andra.
  
Ska-krav
  
  

**För att vara aktuell för uppdraget behöver du ha:**  

Minst 4 års erfarenhet av UX-arbete
  
  

Minst 2 års erfarenhet av design av komplexa interna verktyg
  
  

Minst 2 års erfarenhet av att använda och bidra till designsystem i Figma
  
  

Minst 3 års erfarenhet av agila, tvärfunktionella utvecklingsteam
  
  

Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift
  
  

Möjlighet att arbeta på plats i Stockholm minst 3 dagar per vecka
  
  

Extra meriterande ⭐
  
  

**Det är ett plus om du:**  

Har god erfarenhet av att planera och genomföra research, användartester och analys
  
  

Har en bred UX-verktygslåda och är skicklig på att välja rätt metod för rätt situation
  
  

Är kommunikativ och bra på att förankra design och designbeslut
  
  

Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att förstå komplexa system och arbetsflöden och identifiera förbättringsbehov
  
  

Har erfarenhet av eller intresse för public service, journalistik, media eller radioproduktion
  
  

Praktisk information
  
**Plats:** Stockholm Hybrid: Cirka 60 % på plats och 40 % på distans Start: 5 oktober 2026 Uppdragsperiod: Till 30 april 2027, med möjlighet till förlängning Omfattning:
  
  

100 % från 5 oktober till 31 december 2026
  
  

50 % från 1 januari till 30 april 2027
  
  

Ansökan
  
Skicka in ditt uppdaterade CV på svenska
  
Det är viktigt att ska-kraven framgår tydligt i CV, eftersom erfarenheten behöver kunna verifieras mot respektive krav.
  
  

**I samband med ansökan vill vi även veta:**  

När du är tillgänglig för att påbörja uppdraget
  
  

Varför just din erfarenhet passar uppdraget, gärna med konkreta exempel från tidigare konsultuppdrag, anställningar eller relevanta projekt
  
  

**Sista ansökningsdag:** 20 augusti 2026
  
Urval och presentation kan ske löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt om uppdraget känns intressant.
  
**Kompetenser:** UX · Figma · Designsystem · User Research · Användartester · Agil produktutveckling
  
Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.
  
Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

title: Project Manager - Fire & Security
description:
Job Description:
**Are you our next Project Manager?**

  

Are you an experienced Project Manager or product development professional looking to take the next step in driving complex engineering programs? We’re seeking a proactive leader with strong execution skills and a passion for accelerating sustainable innovation.

 **What drives us at Schneider Electric?**

  

For us, impact isn’t just a term paraded across posters or social media; it’s encoded into our culture. After all, Schneider makes companies, infrastructure, buildings, homes, data centers, and *entire industries* more efficient and sustainable. There’s a reason why we’re consistently ranked among the most sustainable companies in the world. Here, you can pursue your dream career while actively making a long-term, positive impact on the planet.

  

With us, you’ll contribute to tackling the climate crisis head-on, and accelerating the energy transition the planet urgently needs. What’s more, we help tens of millions of people in underserved communities gain access to energy and education — so you’re making the world a fairer place, too. You’ll sit among colleagues with vastly different personal and professional backgrounds, all united by a vision of a better world.

 **Welcome to your workplace**

  

You’ll be based at Schneider Electric’s R&D Innovation Site in Lund — a dynamic hub for cutting-edge development in energy management and automation. The site brings together cross-functional teams in a collaborative, high-tech environment designed to foster innovation, creativity, and continuous learning. With modern labs, agile workspaces, and a strong focus on sustainability, it’s the perfect place to grow your career.

 **What you’ll do**

* Lead program and project execution for our fire and security software offering
* Deliver with Precision: Ensure timely, high-quality delivery with high sense of ownership and accountability for the product portfolio.

Ownership of full life‑cycle delivery for complex, multi‑disciplinary engineering programs (requirements definition architecture development testing industrialization* launch).
* Collaborate Globally: Work across functions in a large, global matrix organization, adapting to time zones as needed. Foster a positive collaborative working environment.
* Being the driving force, highlight problems with the right nuance and simultaneously be mindful of our culture to put people first.
* Having full execution responsibility to meet budget, time plan and quality objectives and communicate efficiently to stakeholders
* Engage with state‑of‑the‑art Fire detection and Access control technologies—including Fire Detection & Access Control softwares and integrations with 3rd party systems —while providing project leadership in a rapidly evolving market that delivers significant positive environmental impact.

**Essential for the role**

* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in project/ program management
* Preference for Advanced Degree and/or Project Management certificate
* Experience leading the end-to-end delivery of new software platforms, from requirements definition and architecture alignment through development, deployment, and commercial release.
* Demonstrated experience managing the continuous development and enhancement of existing software platforms, including regular release cycles, feature expansions, performance improvements, and technology upgrades.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams including Software Engineering, Product Management, QA, UX, DevOps, Cybersecurity, and System Integration teams.
* (Preferred) Demonstrated experience working with Fire Detection & Fire Alarm systems, Access Control, Video Management Systems (VMS), integrations with Building Management System (BMS), third-party APIs and SDKs, related security technologies and applicable standards.
* (Preferred) Experience working within Fire & Life Safety, Access Control, Physical Security, Smart Buildings, Building Automation, or related regulated industries is highly preferred.
* xperience working with cross functional globally distributed teams, including R&D, QA, supply chain, and manufacturing partners across multiple time zones. Demonstrated ability to drive alignment, facilitate technical decision-making, and manage cross-cultural communication.
* You demonstrate excellent people skills with high level of self-awareness
* Structure as a personal strength to build plans, takes decisions based on time aspects, create clarity and provide right amount of structure to make the team successful.

**Location and Language requirements**

* Based in or willing to relocating to Lund, Sweden.
* Language skills: Fluent advanced English (Swedish is a plus)

**Why Schneider Electric?**

* Work on meaningful projects that contribute to a sustainable future in a market with high organic growth
* Hybrid work model and flexible hours
* Inclusive, supportive and diverse work culture with people-first culture
* Global career development opportunities
* Competitive compensation and benefits tailored to the region
* Schneider Electric is an equal‑opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities

**Where can I find out more?**

* About Schneider Electric: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VbldHPFltQQ
* We are proudly #1 in the World’s Most Sustainable Corporation 2025
* Please study our product ranges SpaceLogic and EasyLogic Automation servers and Room controllers on our webpage se.com


Local Benefits (English):

At Schneider, we believe that every employee is a talent who deserves equal opportunities. This means you matter. Every individual needs to feel valued, supported, and treated fairly to do their best work.


Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: “We see you. We value you”. It’s more than just pay and benefits – it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed for you to perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential to shine as an impact maker.

**Schneider Electric is there when it matters most to you**


Our Total Rewards package outlines all the benefits and support you’ll enjoy as part of the Schneider Electric team:

**Care for Yourself and Your Family.** We ensure you feel secure with benefits that help you and your family thrive: important insurances, paid leave, parental and care leave, wellness contribution, flexible working options, employee counseling and a Benefits Portal with various deals and discounts.

**Invest and Plan Your Future.** We help you plan and invest for the future with competitive pay and programs: your base salary, bonus programs, opportunities to own company shares, discounts on company products, referral bonus, pension plans and a digital pension advisory tool.

**Grow Your Skills and Career.** We commit to helping you grow with ongoing performance and development conversations, global career opportunities, access to our Schneider Career Hub for new positions, projects, and mentors, and learning platforms to equip you with the skills for today and tomorrow.

**Team Up in the Workplace.** We encourage teaming up through smart ways to collaborate, employee associations, celebrating contributions via a recognition portal, sharing your voice in our engagement survey, and fostering an inclusive, caring workplace.

**Support Your Community.** We make a difference in your community with volunteer leave, programs through Schneider Electric Foundation, and initiatives that support education.


(External) English Company Boiler Plate: **Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**


When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.


IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.


We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.


Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!


€40 billion global revenue  

+9% organic growth  

150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

  

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled. *Schneider Electric aspires to be the most inclusive and caring company in the world, by providing equitable opportunities to everyone, everywhere, and ensuring all employees feel uniquely valued and safe to contribute their best. We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do.*  

*At Schneider Electric, we uphold the highest standards of ethics and compliance, and we believe that trust is a foundational value. Our Trust Charter is our Code of Conduct and demonstrates our commitment to ethics, safety, sustainability, quality and cybersecurity, underpinning every aspect of our business and our willingness to behave and respond respectfully and in good faith to all our stakeholders. You can find out more about our Trust Charter* *here*  

  

*Schneider Electric is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities in the areas of recruiting, hiring, training, transferring, and promoting all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, color, gender, disability, national origin, ancestry, age, military status, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic or conduct.*

title: UX-designer – Stockholm
description:
Kunden söker en erfaren UX-designer till två tvärfunktionella agila team inom produktutveckling och produktionsverktyg. Tillsammans med teamen utvecklar du verktyg som används av redaktionell personal, exempelvis arkiv, sökverktyg och andra verktyg som underlättar för redaktionerna.

-------------------


* Ansvara för hela designprocessen, från research, facilitering och konceptutveckling till leverans av design och designsystemkomponenter.
* Arbeta iterativt enligt agila metoder med löpande utvärderingar tillsammans med användare, teamet och andra UX-designers.
* Planera fördelningen av arbetstid mellan de två teamen tillsammans med produktägarna.
* Samarbeta mellan team och med andra delar av organisationen, löpande och i dedikerade sprintar.
* Bidra till vidareutvecklingen av kundens interna designsystem i nära samarbete med UX-gruppen och utvecklare.
* Anpassa och välja UX-metoder utifrån rätt skede i utvecklingen.

-------------


* Minst 4 års erfarenhet av att arbeta med UX.
* Minst 2 års erfarenhet av design av komplexa interna verktyg.
* Minst 2 års erfarenhet av att bidra i och använda designsystem i Figma.
* Minst 3 års vana av att arbeta i agila tvärfunktionella utvecklingsteam.
* God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift.
* Möjlighet att vara i Radiohuset i Stockholm minst 3 dagar i veckan.

**Meriterande**
---------------


* God vana av att planera och genomföra research, användartester och analys.
* En bred verktygslåda inom UX och dokumenterat god förmåga att använda rätt metod i rätt sammanhang.
* God kommunikativ förmåga och hög samarbetsförmåga kring design och designbeslut.
* Dokumenterad förmåga att förstå komplexa system eller arbetsflöden och identifiera förbättringsbehov.
* Kännedom om Public Service, intresse för journalistik och radioproduktion samt kunskap om kundens utbud.

title: CRM Manager
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.


We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a **CRM Manager** to join **on-site in our** **Stockholm** office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?

### **The Role**


As a CRM Manager, you will work hands-on throughout the customer messaging process for Viaplay and Allente, from copywriting and message templates to campaign setup, execution and optimization. Working in Adobe Campaign, you will build and send personalized campaigns across channels, then analyze performance and apply learnings to improve future activities. You will work closely with Commercial, Content, Product and Tech teams to deliver relevant customer messaging in the Nordics.

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Write engaging copy for email, push notifications, SMS, direct mail and other CRM channels
* Produce messages, including content, layout, assets and configuration
* Build campaigns from scratch, defining target audiences, business rules and both curated and triggered customer messaging
* Deliver lifecycle campaigns for Viaplay and Allente across multiple markets
* Analyze campaign performance, conduct A/B tests and continuously optimize results through data and insights
* Ensure all customer messaging follows brand guidelines, legal requirements and established CRM processes


We aspire to constantly improve and to learn something from everything we do. You will be challenged, and you will have loads of fun!

### **What we’re looking for**


You are structured, organized and **forward-leaning with a go-getter attitude.** Passionate about creating great customer messaging, you understand how relevant, data-driven communication strengthens the customer experience and commercial performance.


As a **proactive, self-driven doer,** you enjoy working hands-on with both copywriting and marketing automation. You combine creativity with analytical thinking and a keen eye for detail, always looking for ways to improve customer messaging, processes and results.

 **You bring:**

* At least two years of work experience in CRM, Marketing Automation or digital marketing within an international, multi-channel D2C and/or B2B environment
* Strong copywriting skills and experience creating engaging customer messaging across digital channels
* An analytical and commercial mindset with a passion for testing, learning and continuous optimization
* Hands-on experience with Marketing Automation platforms (e.g. Adobe Campaign, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or MessageGears) and familiarity with SQL
* A bachelor's or master's degree in business, marketing, communication or a related field
* Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
* A genuine interest in movies, TV series and/or sports

**It’s a bonus if you have:**

* Project management of complex CRM or marketing automation initiatives, such as implementing new datasets, system functionality or processes
* An eye for UX and UX writing
* Hands-on knowledge of campaign management, CMS and translation tools
* Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders


Most of all, you are curious and keen to learn!

### **What we offer you**

**We’ve got you covered!** 30days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.  

**Your wellbeing matters.** We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.  

**A safe space to grow and up-skill.** Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.  

**Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do**. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including series & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.

### **Hit play today**


If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.  

  

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend (Portfolio Brands)
description:
**Job Description** **WHAT YOU’LL DO**


We are seeking a skilled and experienced **Software Engineer** with expertise in **React, Typescript,** and **Next.JS** to join our dynamic development team. As an experienced Frontend Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing the user interface of our web applications using React and related technologies. You will work in an agile team and collaborate with our product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable, and user-friendly software solutions.  

  

**Some of your responsibilities will include:**

* Design, develop, and maintain responsive, accessible, and high-performance web applications for COS application in Portfolio Brands
* Strong working experience in Next.js, React, Typescript, Tailwind CSS, Github actions
* Experience in system design, headless CMS, component-driven architectures, e-commerce, SaaS, or large-scale enterprise applications
* Based in Stockholm and come to H&M Office in Stockholm atleast 4 days in a week
* Collaborate with product owners, UX/UI designers, architects, and backend engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Drive technical excellence through code reviews, design reviews, and implementation of engineering standards.
* AI First development mindset
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
* Strong understanding of frontend architecture patterns and state management solutions.
* Strong integrating RESTful APIs and GraphQL working with backend services.
* Proficiency with version control systems such as Git.
* Experience with testing frameworks and automated testing strategies.
* Experience with cloud platforms Azure, or Aws or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**


The Portfolio Brands domain enables brand-unique customer experiences and partnership solutions for our four Portfolio Brands. The domain has three areas, PB Digital Experience delivering the e-commerce platform and associated customer facing experience, PB Store Experience enabling our brands to create lasting store experiences for each brand and PB Partnership Solutions supporting PBs growth agenda through external sales.  

  

Digital Experience delivers the e-commerce platform and the ecosystem of composable solutions for our Portfolio Brands, ensuring unique brand experiences can be implemented. The area leads business development and expertise across the e-commerce platform, digital marketing and omni-channel experience, ensuring stable operations as well as strategic vendor management.  

  

COS offers a wardrobe of ready-to-wear, and accessories rooted in exceptional quality and lasting design. The creative soul of the brand is fuelled by a deep connection to modern culture, dynamic global cities and compelling fashion movements. With an emphasis on expert craftsmanship, innovation and materiality, collections are created with a mindful approach, seamlessly blending contemporary and timeless.

 **Qualifications** **WHO YOU ARE**


We are looking for people with…

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), and **6+ years** of experience as a Software Engineer.
* Proven work experience as a Frontend Engineer, preferably with a focus on **Next.JS**
* Strong proficiency in **JavaScript, Typescript,** HTML, and CSS.
* Experience in **system design, headless CMS, component-driven architectures, e-commerce**, SaaS, or large-scale enterprise applications
* Experience with React.js and its core principles.
* Experience with Node.js is preferable.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate with our clients and gather requirements.
* Familiarity with popular React libraries and frameworks such as Redux, React Router, or Next.js.
* Understanding of responsive design principles and mobile-first development.
* Knowledge of frontend build tools and module bundlers such as Webpack or Babel.
* Experience with version control systems, preferably Git.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and communicate technical concepts.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and frameworks.
* Experience with backend technologies and RESTful APIs.
* Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest or React Testing Library.
* Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and ability to work closely with designers.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

  

**Additional Information** **WHO WE ARE**


H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**


At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

* Staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online.
* Included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.
* Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to Swedish market.
* 30 days vacation, health care allowance and good work-life balance.
* Additional perks and discounts from Benify.

**JOIN US**  

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.


This is a fulltime permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is a hybrid position, based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden.

**Apply as soon as possible by sending in your CV in English.** Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page.


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you!

title: UX-designer
description:
**Om företaget**
 Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Här får du vara med och utveckla interna produkter som används dagligen av redaktionell personal i en public service-miljö. Uppdraget omfattar två tvärfunktionella agila team som arbetar med verktyg som arkiv, sökfunktioner och andra lösningar som förenklar och förbättrar det redaktionella arbetet.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära produktägare, utvecklare och andra UX-designers och tar ansvar för hela designprocessen. Rollen spänner från att förstå användarnas behov till att omsätta insikter i hållbara designlösningar och komponenter i designsystemet. Samarbetet mellan teamen är en viktig del av vardagen, både löpande och i mer fokuserade sprintar.
   

  

 Det här är en spännande möjlighet för dig som vill arbeta användarnära, påverka flera produkter samtidigt och bidra till en sammanhållen design i en komplex verksamhet.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
* Du driver hela designprocessen från research och facilitering till konceptutveckling och färdig design.
* Du utvecklar UX för interna verktyg som stödjer redaktionella arbetsflöden, exempelvis arkiv- och sökverktyg.
* Du samarbetar tätt med två agila team, produktägare, utvecklare och andra UX-designers.
* Du planerar och genomför iterativt arbete enligt agila metoder med löpande utvärdering tillsammans med användare och team.
* Du bidrar till att vidareutveckla det interna designsystemet och tar fram designsystemkomponenter i nära samarbete med utvecklare och UX-kollegor.
* Du hjälper teamen att välja rätt UX-metoder i rätt skede av utvecklingen och skapar struktur i komplexa designfrågor.


**Krav**
* Minst 4 års erfarenhet av att jobba med UX.
* Minst 2 års erfarenhet av att arbeta med design av komplexa interna verktyg.
* Minst 2 års erfarenhet av att bidra i och använda designsystem i Figma.
* Minst 3 års vana av att jobba i agila tvärfunktionella utvecklingsteam.
* God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift.
* Du kan arbeta på plats minst 3 dagar i veckan.


**Meriterande**
* God vana av att planera och genomföra research, användartester och analys.
* En bred verktygslåda inom UX och dokumenterat god förmåga att använda rätt metod i rätt sammanhang.
* Dokumenterad förmåga att förstå komplexa system eller arbetsflöden och identifiera förbättringsbehov.
* God samarbetsförmåga kring design och designbeslut.
* Kännedom om public service, intresse för journalistik och radioproduktion samt förståelse för verksamhetens utbud.


**Vi erbjuder**
* Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
* Tjänstepension
* Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år


**Ansökan**
 Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

title: H&M - Denim Designer - Womenswear
description:
**Job Description**

 Join H&M and shape the future of womenswear denim.
   

  





 We're looking for a visionary Denim Designer with a strong creative point of view, exceptional product knowledge, and an instinct for what's next. In this role, you'll create collections that define the balance between timeless denim essentials and fashion-forward statement pieces, translating emerging trends into desirable products for millions of customers around the world.
   

  





 Working at the heart of our Womenswear Denim team, you'll drive the creative development of silhouettes, fits, washes, fabric innovations, and finishes, building collections that are both trend-relevant and commercially impactful. From concept to final product, you'll collaborate closely with Product Developers, Planners, and global suppliers to bring modern denim stories to life at scale.
   

  





 We're looking for a designer who lives and breathes denim—someone with a sharp fashion eye, a deep understanding of construction and craftsmanship, and the confidence to challenge conventions while delivering for a global customer. You'll thrive in a fast-moving, close-to-season environment, combining creativity with commercial awareness to create products that inspire.
   

  





**What you'll bring**



* BA/MA in Fashion or Textile Design, or equivalent experience
* At least 3 years' experience designing denim within womenswear
* Deep expertise in denim fabrics, garment construction, washes, finishes, and fit development
* Experience from an aspirational international fashion brand or retailer
* International experience is an advantage
* A strong understanding of current and emerging denim trends, with the ability to translate inspiration into commercially relevant collections
* A customer-first mindset and passion for creating fashion for H&M's global womenswear customer
* Experience collaborating with suppliers, laundries, and manufacturing partners across Asia and Europe
* Advanced skills in Adobe Creative Suite; experience with CLO 3D is a plus
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to inspire and influence cross-functional teams
* A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with natural ownership and leadership qualities
* Excellent organizational skills, able to manage multiple priorities and timelines
* Adaptability and energy to succeed in a fast-paced, ever-evolving fashion environment
* Fluent English; Swedish is not required



**Additional Information**




 This role is based in Stockholm and reports to the Assortment Manager. You'll join a passionate team of Designers, Product Developers, and Planners who are driven by creativity, innovation, and a shared ambition to shape the future of fashion.
   

  





 If this sounds like you, we'd love to see your application. Please submit your CV along with a portfolio (PDF, maximum 10MB) showcasing your creative vision, mood boards, design process, fit and wash developments, fabric innovation, and final collections. We encourage you to include work that reflects the aspirational H&M Womenswear customer and demonstrates both your creative thinking and commercial understanding. All application materials should be submitted in English.
   

  





 At H&M Group, you'll enjoy attractive benefits, global career opportunities, and a staff discount across all H&M Group brands—including H&M, COS, ARKET, & Other Stories, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, and Afound. You'll also be part of our H&M Incentive Program (HIP), rewarding our shared success.
   

  





 At H&M, we're committed to creating an inclusive recruitment process. To help ensure fair and unbiased hiring, we kindly ask that you do not include a cover letter with your application.
   

  





 Shape the next generation of denim.
   

  





 At H&M, fashion is constantly evolving—and so are we. From elevated wardrobe icons to trend-defining fashion moments, we create accessible design with global impact. If you're passionate about pushing denim forward and creating collections that inspire customers around the world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Digital Product Designer - Design System
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**




 As a Digital Product Designer in the Design System team, you’ll play a key role in evolving and scaling H&M’s customer-facing design system across app and web. You will help create a cohesive visual language that strengthens H&M brand expression while enabling product teams to deliver high-quality experiences efficiently and consistently.
   

  





 This is a role for someone with exceptional UI craft and strong systems thinking. You understand that great design systems are more than components and documentation — they are the foundation that brings coherence, quality and brand differentiation across every digital touchpoint.
   

  





 You’ll work at the intersection of brand, design and technology, translating design principles and brand identity into scalable foundations, tokens, components and guidelines that work seamlessly across iOS, Android and web. You have a sharp eye for visual detail, understand what elevates a digital experience and can balance aesthetic excellence with platform-specific best practices.
   

  





 You will:
   

  




* Drive the evolution of H&M’s design system foundations, visual language and component library across app and web.
* Translate brand identity into scalable design foundations, guidelines and reusable patterns.
* Create alignment and visual coherence across iOS, Android and web while respecting platform-specific conventions.
* Define and refine design tokens, typography systems, spacing systems, colour systems and interaction principles.
* Partner closely with designers, engineers and product teams to ensure consistent implementation and adoption.
* Provide guidance and direction on visual quality, UI patterns and brand alignment across product teams.
* Champion accessibility best practices and ensure inclusive design is embedded into system foundations.
* Facilitate design reviews, workshops and discussions that drive alignment across a large product organisation.
* Stay up to date with emerging design, fashion, digital and consumer experience trends and identify opportunities to evolve the design system.
* Contribute to design system governance, documentation and community engagement across the organisation.



 The role is based in Stockholm, with an expectation of being onsite at least 4 days per week.
   

  





**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**




 You will join the Digital Product Design organisation at H&M and become part of the Fabric Design System Product team.
   

  





 You’ll work closely with experience designers, design leads, engineers and product teams across app and web. You will collaborate with colleagues in Design, Product, Engineering and Brand to ensure H&M delivers a consistent, high-quality customer experience across all digital touchpoints.
   

  





 You will also act as a trusted expert and partner to the wider design community, helping teams make informed decisions about visual design, interaction patterns and brand expression.
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE**




 We are looking for people with:
   

  




* Extensive experience designing and evolving design systems for large-scale digital products.
* Exceptional UI and visual design skills with a strong portfolio demonstrating attention to detail and design craft.
* Deep understanding of cross-platform design across iOS, Android and web and their native patterns.
* Strong experience translating brand principles and visual identities into scalable digital systems.
* Expertise in typography, colour, spacing, layout and visual hierarchy.
* Experience defining and implementing design tokens and system foundations.
* Strong understanding of accessibility and inclusive design practices, including WCAG guidelines.
* Experience collaborating closely with engineers and understanding the realities of implementation.
* Experience influencing and aligning multiple stakeholders across a matrix organisation.
* Proven experience working with Figma and modern design system tooling.



 Extra consideration will be given to candidates who have:
   

  




* Experience working with premium consumer brands or fashion brands in e-commerce.
* Experience building and scaling design systems across both mobile and web platforms.
* Experience defining design principles, governance models or contribution frameworks.
* Experience working within large international product organisations.



 And people who are:
   

  




* Passionate about visual quality and design excellence.
* Naturally curious about trends in fashion, digital design and consumer behaviour.
* Skilled at identifying the small details that elevate an experience from good to exceptional.
* Comfortable balancing creativity, brand expression and system scalability.
* Collaborative, generous and motivated by raising the quality of work around them.
* Confident providing design direction while building trust and alignment across teams.
* Energised by creating clarity and consistency in complex environments.
* Driven by customer value, craftsmanship and continuous improvement.


**Additional Information**

**WHO WE ARE**




 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by a shared culture and strong values. Together, we aim to use our scale and knowledge to push the industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**




 At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer:
   

  




* Global career and development opportunities
* A value‑driven culture where you are encouraged to be yourself
* Staff discount cards and benefits
* Wellness and wellbeing benefits
* Parental support
* Opportunities to experiment, grow, and create tangible impact in a large‑scale tech organization



 Here, you are encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and grow — and as you flourish, so do we.
   

  





**JOIN US**




 Our uniqueness comes from our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and the growth opportunities we create. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 Take the next step in your career — the journey starts here.
   

  





**Please attach your CV in English together with your portfolio** 
 — no cover letter is needed.
   

  





*We are committed to a fair, equitable recruitment process based on competency, so we kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter.*

title: Product Manager (Identity & Access Management)
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.
   

  

 Why Lovable?
   

  

 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

* Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.
* A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.
* Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.
* Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.
* Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.
* Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.
* A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.


 What you’ll do
   

  

* Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.
* Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.
* Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.
* Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.
* Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.
* Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.
* Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.


 Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable.
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Product Manager – Survey & Design
description:
*10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that.*
*With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time.*
*Founded in 2022, and with 1200+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034.*
***About the Survey & Design team:***
 The Survey & Design team is part of the Acquisition Area of Aira, which is responsible for the entire sales journey, from lead generation to installed heat pump. Our team sits right in the middle of this, with a critical mission:
   

  

 Build tools that help Aira qualify, size, and design the right energy solution for every home — tools that get more accurate with every installation we do.
   

  

 When selling a heat pump system, you need to know what size of heat pump should be installed and whether any radiators need replacing. If we over-estimate this number, the customer will be paying more than they have to. If we under-estimate this number, we could install a heat pump that is unable to heat our customers' homes. Getting it right is crucial for both conversion and fast, efficient installations. And Aira is uniquely positioned to solve this: we own the entire feedback loop, from qualification through to monitoring the installed heat pump.
   

  

***About the role:***
 Your main stakeholders are our Design Engineers, who work in customers' homes, but our tools impact almost every role in the Aira sales funnel, from Qualification, Sales, and Design all the way to Procurement, Planning, and Installation. You'll own the product direction for these tools across all our markets (UK, Germany, and Italy), offices (Stockholm and Helsingborg), and the factory (Poland).
   

  

 You'll lead a cross-functional team of software engineers and a designer, with a high degree of autonomy.
   

  

***Key responsibilities:***
* Lead a cross-functional team of software engineers and a product designer, setting priorities and deciding what to build, when, and why.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Aira's survey, heat loss, and design tooling, ensuring alignment with the Acquisition Area's goal of profitable, high-quality installations.
* Drive the team's long-term differentiator: an accuracy-and-learning loop that uses installation telemetry to measure and reduce heat loss estimation error at every stage of the funnel.
* Become the domain expert on heat loss calculations, balancing each market's regulatory requirements against Aira's business goals.
* Act as the bridge between deep technical work and the field reality of a Design Engineer working on an iPad in a customer's home.
* Drive the roll-out of our tools across all markets and make sure they're adopted across every user group.
* Define the metrics and track how we're progressing toward our goals.


***We expect you to have:***
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Engineering, Business, or a related discipline).
* 3 years of experience in a similar Product Manager role, leading cross-functional teams of engineers and designers.
* The ability to own a technically and domain-complex product. You don't need to be a heating engineer, but you must be comfortable diving into a quantitative, calculation-driven domain and earning the trust of expert users.
* Strong data and analytics instincts: defining the right metrics, designing measurement (and recognising when a metric is misleading), and using data to drive decisions.


***It would be a bonus if you:***
* Have studied thermodynamics.
* Are a homeowner, as it helps you understand the challenges our users face every day.
* Have experience building tools for field-based, operational, or expert workforces.
* Can speak German or Italian.


**What is in it for you?**
* Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
* Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.
* Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
* Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
* Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.
* Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.


 At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

title: IT-säkerhetsspecialist till Höglandets IT
description:
Höglandsförbundet – Samverkan är vår styrka!
  
Höglandsförbundet är ett kommunalförbund bildat av Aneby, Eksjö, Nässjö, Sävsjö och Vetlanda. Dessa fem kommuner, på småländska höglandet, värdesätter samarbete och vet att vi blir starkare tillsammans. Genom att slå ihop våra styrkor och resurser kan vi öka kompetensen, bättre utnyttja resurser, höja kvaliteten och ge invånarna bättre service. Hos oss finns idag en rad olika verksamheter som arbetar för hela Höglandets bästa.
  
  

1 plats(er).
  
  

Brinner du för att stå emot cyberattacker och skydda en organisations digitala tillgångar? Då kan det här vara tjänsten för dig! Vi söker nu en IT-säkerhetsspecialist till Höglandets IT.
  
Ditt nya jobb
  
I rollen som IT-säkerhetsspecialist ingår det att arbeta operativt med organisationens IT-säkerhet. Det ingår också att kontinuerligt följa utvecklingen inom IT-säkerhetsområdet för att kunna rekommendera och tillämpa lämpliga metoder och tekniker i det förebyggande säkerhetsarbetet.
  
Arbetet innebär att utbilda, informera och stödja olika projekt och verksamheter inom organisationen samt fungera som ett kompetensstöd i frågor som rör IT-säkerhet. Rollen omfattar även att genomföra regelbundna säkerhetsanalyser för att identifiera, förebygga och varna för sårbarheter i IT-system och tekniska miljöer.
  
I din arbetsuppgifter ingår också att förvalta, underhålla och implementera IT-säkerhetslösningar samt att medverka i processer för att granska och godkänna system ur ett säkerhetsperspektiv. Det ingår också att ta fram skyddsåtgärder och säkerställa att beslutade åtgärdsplaner genomförs.
  
Rollen innebär dessutom att delta i Höglandsförbundets informationssäkerhetsarbete och bidra till utvecklingen av organisationens övergripande säkerhetsnivå.
  
Om dig
  
Vi söker dig som har relevant högskole- eller yrkesutbildning inom IT eller motsvarande. Du behöver ha erfarenhet av systematiskt IT-säkerhetsarbete med stöd av ramverk som ISO 27002, CIS Controls v8 eller NIST 2.0. Du har också erfarenhet av att rekommendera olika säkerhetslösningar och åtgärder utifrån ett balanserat risk- och säkerhetsperspektiv. Det är också av vikt att du har god förmåga att uttrycka dig både på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
  
Du har en personlig drivkraft och är orädd för att ta dig an komplexa arbetsuppgifter. Det är viktigt för oss att du har god samarbetsförmåga då arbetet innebär samverkan med många olika parter, både internt och externt. Du är tekniskt skicklig, prestigelös, analytisk. För att trivas i rollen behöver du också ha god problemlösningsförmåga.
  
I rollen krävs också att du är strukturerad, drivande och målinriktad och har ett gediget intresse kring IT-säkerhet.
  
Om oss
  
Höglandets IT är Höglandskommunernas leverantör av IT-tjänster. Kommunerna på höglandet står inför en omvälvande och spännande förändringsresa mot det digitala tjänstesamhället. Där är Höglandets IT en viktig aktör.
  
Höglandets IT är en arbetsplats som präglas av öppenhet, respekt och gott bemötande. Man stimulerar till kreativitet, lärande och utveckling och har naturligtvis en god balans mellan arbete och fritid.
  
Vi är den naturliga samarbetspartnern för kommunerna och deras bolag när det gäller att realisera framtidens e-förvaltning och det IT-stöd som krävs för detta. Ett aktivt samarbete med andra offentliga aktörer i regionen är också en viktig del. Vi är mitt uppe i ett spännande förändringsarbete där vi bygger vidare på vår organisation och den gemensamma tekniska infrastruktur som krävs för att kunna förverkliga samverkansfördelarna med en gemensam IT-organisation för Höglandskommunerna.
  
Vi levererar dagligen pålitliga IT-tjänster till cirka 32 000 användare inom olika kommunala sektorer såsom skola, vård-och omsorg, kultur- och fritid, fastighet, bygg, samt vatten och avlopp. Vår IT- miljö är en av de största och mest utmanande i regionen, med ett omfattande antal enheter och infrastrukturkomponenter.
  
Bra att veta
  
Ansökan avser en tillsvidareanställning på Höglandets IT. Tjänsten kommer vara placerad i Eksjö. Resor i tjänsten kan förkomma mellan Höglandets orter. Möjlighet till arbete hemifrån enligt överenskommelse.
  
En anställning hos oss som IT-säkerhetsspecialist innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kommer att genomföras före beslut om anställning.
  
Om du blir kallad till intervju behöver du kunna styrka ditt medborgarskap. Detta gör du genom att visa upp ett giltigt pass eller ett personbevis tillsammans med en giltig ID-handling. Personbevis kan, om du är svensk medborgare, laddas ner från skatteverket under mina sidor. Om du är medborgare i ett land utanför EU/EES ska du även kunna uppvisa giltigt uppehålls- och/eller arbetstillstånd för att arbeta i Sverige. Anställning kan ske först efter att arbetstillståndet har kontrollerats, i enlighet med utlänningsförordningen.
  
Vill du veta mer?
  
Välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Adis Jakupovic. Vill du kontakta facklig representant kontaktar du Lars Ulvemo.
  
Välkommen med din ansökan!
  
Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.
  
**Löneform:** Månadslön.
  
**Anställningsform:** Tillsvidareanställning.
  
**Varaktighet:** Tillsvidare, tillträde: 2026-11-02 eller enligt överenskommelse.

title: Data Engineer
description:
If you’re looking to make the best co-op games in the world, you’ve come to the right place. We're proud to have some of the best game makers and collaborators in the industry working with us. What's more, we're a fun bunch of game developers, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together. Our games are not for everyone. Are they for you?
  
We are now looking for a Data Engineer!
  
As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, optimization, and operation of our data infrastructure and backend systems. You will work closely with a collaborative team of engineers, focusing on technologies such as SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, Azure, C# and ASP.NET Core. If you are passionate about building scalable, efficient, data-driven backend solutions, we want to hear from you.
  
  

**Who you are:**  

You have experience tuning all aspects of SQL Server, including query and execution-plan analysis and know exactly where to place the right index.
  
  

Your savvy troubleshooting skills include identifying and mitigating locking and concurrency issues.
  
  

You know what is important when it comes to observability and monitoring, what needs acting on as well as identifying blind spots.
  
  

You are comfortable automating and orchestrating repetitive tasks such as reports and data exports.
  
  

You are experienced with data classification and different retention needs.
  
  

You have experience in backend development using C# and ASP.NET Core.
  
  

You are familiar with cloud platform providers such as Azure and their data infrastructure services.
  
  

**What you'll do:**  

**Database management:** Design and implement efficient database structures using SQL Server, optimizing data storage, and retrieval for optimal system performance.
  
  

**Database operations:** Ensure database operations under sustained production load are healthy and performant, supporting both players, designers and fellow developers in their day-to-day activities.
  
  

**Database observability:** Create and maintain alert rules, the SQL metrics exporter, Grafana dashboards, and Extended-Events-based performance diagnostics.
  
  

**Data pipelines:** Operate and evolve the Azure Data Factory pipelines, maintenance, and telemetry events.
  
  

**Application development:** Design and develop backend solutions using C#, ASP.NET Core, and Microsoft Orleans, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  
  

**Cloud integration:** Utilize Azure services to build and optimize cloud-based backend components, ensuring seamless integration with our applications.
  
  

**Collaboration:** Work closely with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to understand requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure the successful delivery of projects.
  
  

Our tech stack
  
Azure SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, NET/C#, ASPNET Core, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, CosmosDB, Redis, Grafana, MS Orleans, Kafka
  
  

How to apply
  
If you think that this position matches your background and skills, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV in English as soon as possible. We ask that your application always include relevant work samples or a link to your portfolio.
  
We interview candidates continuously and hire when we find a good fit.
  
Practical Information
  
**Scope:** Full-time: 40 hours per week with initial 6 month probation period. Location: Office first.
  
We are a pet friendly office! You can expect to find cute dogs and occasionally some cats around.
  
What we offer
  
Arrowhead Game Studios is a growing team of about 140+ people, best known for our co-op titles. Despite our size, we remain a friendly and down to earth bunch, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together.
  
Located in the heart of Södermalm, in Fatburen in the middle of the Game Dev scene we enjoy everything Stockholm has to offer. The is a a lot of different types of activities immediately available on our doorstep.
  
Our talented developers are crucial to our success, therefore we put a lot of emphasis in creating and maintaining a prosperous culture. We’re committed to open and transparent communication. Your ideas are welcomed, valued, appreciated - the ceiling for creative discussions is high.
  
We also have numerous work benefits for all our employees. You can read about them here!
  
Öppen för alla
  
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Jeppesen ForeFlight**


**Senior Software Engineer**


**Location:** Sweden | **Employment Type:** Full-time | **Team:** Engineering


**About Jeppesen ForeFlight**
-----------------------------



Jeppesen ForeFlight brings together decades of Jeppesen's aeronautical data expertise with ForeFlight's award-winning flight planning and navigation platform. Our software supports pilots, airlines, and flight departments around the world, delivering mission-critical tools for safe and efficient flight operations. As we continue to grow our presence in Europe, we're building out our Sweden-based team to help design and build the systems behind our products.


**About the Role**
------------------



We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team in Sweden. You'll take on complex technical problems across our flight planning, navigation, and aeronautical data products, working with a high degree of independence while helping raise the technical bar for the team around you. You'll partner closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to design and ship reliable, high-quality software used by pilots and flight operations teams worldwide.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Design, build, and ship high-quality, well-tested software across the stack, taking ownership of complex features from design through delivery.
* Make sound architectural and design decisions, weighing trade-offs between speed, scalability, and maintainability.
* Work closely with product managers and designers to shape requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
* Mentor other engineers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance, helping raise the overall quality bar of the team.
* Identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks proactively.
* Contribute to system design and architecture discussions, including for cross-team or company-wide initiatives.
* Write and maintain automated tests, and champion strong engineering practices including CI/CD and code review standards.
* Participate in on-call rotations and incident response, helping diagnose and resolve production issues.
* Collaborate with engineers across time zones, including teams in Europe and the US, to align on shared systems and priorities.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record of shipping production software independently.
* Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages relevant to our stack (e.g., Java, Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#).
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience with API design, databases, and building reliable, scalable services or applications.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS or GCP) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike.
* Experience with modern engineering practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, and code review.
* Based in Sweden or willing to work from our Sweden location, with authorization to work in the EU.

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Experience building software in aviation, geospatial, or other safety-critical, data-intensive domains.
* Full-stack experience across front-end and backend systems.
* Experience mentoring engineers or informally leading technical initiatives.
* Familiarity with event-driven or streaming architectures (e.g., Kafka, SQS).
* Interest in aviation or flight operations.

**What We Offer**
-----------------


* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* The chance to work on software that supports pilots and flight operations globally.
* A collaborative, international team spanning Europe and the US.
* Flexible working arrangements and a strong culture of continuous learning.
* Opportunities for professional growth within a growing European engineering hub.


Jeppesen ForeFlight is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: SAP Solution Architect Finance to Cash
description:
**Job description**
-------------------



At Billerud we believe that when we have tomorrow in mind, we will do our very best today. Do you want to realize your true value and work for a sustainable tomorrow? Join us!

In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring that SAP solutions support business objectives across multiple regions and business units.

Experience from one or more process areas within Commercial and Supply chain and related SAP modules.

  

Experience managing budgets, financial follow-up, and resource planning.  

Previous formal leadership experience is considered a strong advantage.

  

Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

You know how to build trust, facilitating discussions, and navigating challenging situations with a constructive and solution-oriented approach. You dare to challenge assumptions when needed and can communicate complex topics in a clear and engaging way.

  



As a person, you are organized, proactive, and resilient under pressure. You have a strong sense of accountability and a genuine motivation to help teams succeed and deliver results together.

  



Our values are central to our business, and we believe you recognize yourself in: We care for each other and We do what we say!

title: Programmerare
description:
### **Jobba med oss på**

Fyrstads Entek

Ljungskile
