title: AI Engineer
description:
Ready to combine strong engineering skills, an entrepreneurial mindset and a passion for AI to help redefine the future of digital banking? As an AI Engineer at Nordiska, you’ll build production-ready AI solutions that improve our products, transform how we work and create new business opportunities. You will help us turn rapid advances in AI into tangible business value with unprecedented speed.

**Bank at core, innovation at heart**  

Nordiska is a bank offering a complete range of financial services, allowing us to tailor solutions to each customer while simultaneously enabling them to gain access to advanced financial technology. Part of our offering is our Embedded platform, enabling enterprise partners across Europe to seamlessly integrate financial services – including saving, lending, and payments – into innovative product offerings. Additionally, we provide corporate and real estate financing, as well as sustainable savings with a government-backed deposit guarantee.


To meet future demands, we continuously scale our modern technology platform, expand partner integrations, and accelerate product innovation to help shape the future of financial services.

**Working at Nordiska**


Since our founding, we have been committed to driving innovation and creating meaningful impact. We work towards an ambitious vision and goals, backed up by our history of successfully delivering high-quality results and sustainable growth.


Historically and going forward, the people working at Nordiska are what enables our success. We balance our professional environment with an entrepreneurial mindset, always acting with honesty and responsibility, to build long-term trust among customers, partners and employees.

**About the Role**


As an AI Engineer, you will join our Data & AI team and play an important part in Nordiska’s AI ambitions. We have a strong focus on integrating AI into how we build products, improve operations, and develop our business.  

AI is fundamentally changing what can be built, how teams operate, and how quickly new business value can be created. You will work closely with engineers, data specialists, product teams, and business stakeholders to turn that potential into practical solutions.


This is an entrepreneurial role in a fast-moving field. You will have the opportunity to explore new ideas, influence technical decisions, and take solutions from early concepts to production. At the same time, you will balance speed and experimentation with the security, reliability, and regulatory expectations of a bank.

**In the role, you will:**

* Identify and develop AI use cases that create measurable value for customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Design, build, test, and deploy generative AI and machine learning solutions.
* Develop applications and services using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, and related technologies.
* Integrate AI capabilities into Nordiska’s products, platforms, and internal workflows.
* Build evaluation and monitoring processes for solution quality, performance, cost, and reliability.
* Experiment with emerging models, frameworks, and approaches, turning promising ideas into practical solutions.
* Write maintainable, well-tested code and contribute to shared engineering standards, documentation, and code reviews.
 **Your Professional Profile**

* Curious and adaptable: You enjoy learning and feel motivated by a field where technologies, opportunities, and ways of working change quickly.
* Entrepreneurial and product-minded: You take initiative, identify opportunities, and focus on turning ideas into solutions that create real business value.
* Collaborative and responsible: You take ownership of your work, communicate openly, and understand the importance of quality, security, and trust.

**We believe that you have:**

* A degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or another relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong programming skills in Python, C#, or a comparable language, together with sound software engineering fundamentals.
* Knowledge of machine learning, generative AI, and the principles behind modern AI systems.
* Practical experience from professional work, academic projects, internships, open-source contributions, or personal AI projects.
* Familiarity with relevant frameworks and tools, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or large language model APIs.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to move from an initial idea to a working solution.
* Strong communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.


Experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, Goose, or similar orchestration tools is considered an advantage. Experience with LLM application development, MLOps, data engineering, C#/.NET, or designing and operating cloud infrastructure at scale in Azure, AWS, or GCP is also valuable, as is knowledge of Swedish or financial services.

**Application**


If you’re looking to join a growth-driven environment that pairs innovation with profitability and reliability, welcome to Nordiska. We look forward to receiving your application.


We review and interview continuously, with background checks as part of the final stage of our process. For questions about the role and or more information, you are warmly welcome to contact Lydia Cezar at lydia.cezar@nordiska.com

title: Vice President, R&D
description:
*You'll own the technology direction for the platforms our 200+ utility customers run their business on. You'll lead managers, not just individual contributors, through a shift to AI-powered development. And you'll do it with real ownership from day one. This is your next move as Vice President, R&D at EG.*

 **As Part of the department**  

Leading R&D for the Software Utility Companies Run On Zynergy and Xellent are EG's core software platforms for Utility, relied on by more than 200 customers across the Nordics every day. As Vice President, R&D, you'll lead the shift toward AI and automated development, and set the technology strategy that keeps both platforms reliable as electrification, flexibility markets and new regulation reshape the sector.


You'll lead an international R&D organisation of around 120 people across Denmark, Sweden, Poland and India, with 5 direct reports. You'll report to Bjarki Björnsson, Senior Vice President for Utility, and join the Utility management team. The role is based in Stockholm.

 **Your Role: Own the Technology Direction, End to End**  

*Real ownership of an international development organisation, a genuine AI agenda with direct customer impact, and a platform for your next move in EG's leadership team.*


The R&D organisation is yours to lead. You own development strategy, architecture, delivery and quality across the Utility portfolio, working closely with Product Management, Customer Support and Professional Services. You'll also set the AI agenda for Utility and share practice with R&D leaders across EG.  

**Key responsibilities:**

* **International development organisation —** lead and grow a distributed team across the Nordics and Mangalore, building one culture with strong local leadership and a deliberate onshore/offshore balance.
* **AI in our products and how we build them —** set the AI agenda for Utility end to end, and raise engineering productivity through AI-assisted development, automated testing and modern tooling.
* **Technology and architecture —** own the target architecture and modernisation roadmap for Zynergy and Xellent, balancing new capability, technical debt and long product lifecycles.
* **Delivery, quality and commercial ownership —** own release predictability and compliance and manage the R&D budget with a commercial mindset.
* **Talent and customer proximity —** attract, develop and retain leaders, and stay close to our 200+ customers to turn their reality into clear priorities.

**Your Profile: Technical Depth, Commercial Judgement, Real Leadership**  

Strategic thinking comes naturally, paired with the willingness to stay close to the technology, the teams and the customers. Transformation motivates you, and you know how to lead change across cultures, locations and time zones. The big picture stays in view, without losing focus on what matters most. Structure, development standards and continuous improvement matter to you, and you work closely with Product Management, Professional Services, Customer Success and Sales — sharing practice with R&D leaders across EG along the way.


Your background can vary, but to thrive in this role, you:

* Have proven experience leading R&D or engineering organisations at scale in an international software or SaaS company, including distributed teams.
* Bring strong technology judgement across cloud, data, architecture and the modernisation of established products.
* Have a practical, hands-on view of AI in a product context — from data foundation and governance to what turns into real customer value in production.
* Have a performance mindset grounded in evidence, with strong execution and a bias for action.
* Build trust as a leader, develop other leaders, and sustain motivation through change.
* Are curious, ambitious, and eager to grow in a fast-paced environment.
* Relevant master's degree in engineering, computer science or similar.

**What's in it for You?**  

At EG, you will be trusted to set direction, drive change and take responsibility from day one. As part of our leadership team, you will have the mandate to influence strategy and build high-performing teams, in a collaborative, international culture where ambition goes hand in hand with trust and personal growth.

* **Meaningful impact —** lead teams that solve real challenges and build software that makes a difference in society and business.
* **Real ownership —** take responsibility from day one, with the freedom to shape your role, influence strategy and drive change.
* **Continuous growth —** find the space, support and opportunities to grow and take on new challenges.
* **Collaborative culture —** join a global, ambitious leadership team rooted in Nordic values, where collaboration and trust help us succeed together.
* **AI at the frontier —** put AI to work across our products and how we build them, with direct visibility into what it means for more than 200 customers.

**Our Values:**

* **Lead the Industry** — We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
* **Make it Happen** — We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
* **Stronger Together** — We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.

**We Look Forward to Hearing From You!**  

If you would like more information before you apply, please contact Bjarki Björnsson, SVP Utility, on +45 20 69 95 85. We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and recruit when the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially. Please submit your application through our recruitment system using the Apply button.

**At EG, we build software that makes a difference.**  

Our industry-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.


Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security. If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here.


Join us in creating software that works for people - not software that makes people work.


Curious what it's really like to work at EG?


Explore life at EG, meet some of your future colleagues, and see our values in action: Working at EG


See all our open positions here


Learn more about EG here.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Description** **About the Role**


We’re looking for a **Senior Platform Engineer** to help us develop and operate our Kubernetes-based multi-cluster internal developer platform that powers mission-critical microservices across the organization.


You will work closely with product teams, platform architects, and engineering managers to evolve our platform into a highly automated, self-service ecosystem that accelerates developer productivity and enables secure, seamless deployments at scale.


Our technical stack includes **Azure Kubernetes Service, Envoy Gateway, Opentelemetry Operator, LGTM Stack, Crossplane, KEDA, Cert Manager, External DNS, Kyverno, External Secrets Operator, Argo CD, Helm, Bicep, Github Actions.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Treat the platform as a product. This involves gathering feedback, identifying friction, and continuously improving workflows and interfaces.
* Design, build, and operate cloud-native infrastructure with an everything-as-code mindset.
* Write production-quality code (Bash, YAML, Bicep, Github Actions)
* Drive complex features and refactoring efforts across provisioning, deployments, observability, and cluster lifecycle management.
* Partner closely with product teams to understand real workflows and deliver a frictionless self-service experience.

**WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH**


You will be working in a team with experienced Platform Engineers and Site Reliability Engineers within Platform Engineering. Our sister-teams within Platform Engineering area are Quality Engineering, Development Tools and Applications (CICD/Applications scaffolding).

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 5+ experience in platform engineering, SRE, or application engineering roles.
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes, containers, and the cloud-native ecosystem.
* A builder mindset - you write and ship code regularly.
* Excellent technical writing skills.
* Experience operating in public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) with modern IaC and GitOps tooling.
* Proven track record improving developer workflows, self-service capabilities, or internal platforms.
* Understanding of networking (TLS, DNS, HTTP, GRPC, proxies).
* Experience with modern observability practices and tooling (instrumentation, metrics, logs, tracing, profiling).

**WHY JOIN US**

* Make a real impact - you’ll have significant influence over the direction of the platform and shape how platform engineering works across the company.
* Platform at the center of transformation - as the organization continues its transition to microservices, the platform sits at pole position, with rapid growth and growing strategic importance.
* Modern, cloud-native stack - we invest in staying current with the cloud-native ecosystem and evolving our architecture accordingly.
* Ideas matter here - we value curiosity, experimentation, and thoughtful innovation, and give engineers space to turn ideas into reality.
* Supportive, low-ego culture - you’ll work with collaborative teammates who care about helping each other succeed and building great things together.

**WHO WE ARE**  

H&M Group is a global company with strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we use our scale and knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**

* At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
* All our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP)
* Staff discount usable across all H&M Group brands, in stores and online
* Work-life balance, 30 days’ vacation, and wellness allowance of 4000 SEK/year
* Access to Benify for discounts on gym memberships, travel, hotels, and more
* Compensation boost during parental leave

**JOIN US**


Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are.


This is a full-time, permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is hybrid, based in Stockholm, Sweden, where close collaboration with stakeholders is an important part of the role.


Apply by submitting your **CV in English** as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page.


We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter.


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you!

title: SAP Basis Lead
description:
**Job description**
-------------------



At Billerud we believe that when we have tomorrow in mind, we will do our very best today. It is thanks to our employees that we are a world-leading company within the field of renewable paper and packaging materials. Do you want to realize your true value and work for a sustainable tomorrow? Join us!

  



Are you an experienced SAP Basis professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with leadership and collaboration across global teams? A unique opportunity to shape and develop Billerud’s future global SAP landscape in a true greenfield transformation.

  



As part of our continued SAP development journey, we are looking for a SAP Basis Lead to join our Global SAP Applications team. In this role, you will lead SAP Basis and platform activities and contribute to the development of a future-proof SAP landscape that supports business needs today and in the future.

  

**About the role**  

As SAP Basis Lead, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and leading daily SAP Basis and platform activities across our SAP environment. You will work closely with the AMS partner, internal stakeholders, project teams, SAP, and external vendors to ensure stable operations, successful implementations, and continuous improvements.

  

The role combines technical leadership, SAP platform management, administration, and collaboration across multiple functions, making it an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with both operations and development in a global environment.

  

  

**Your main tasks will be**:  

* Lead SAP system installations, upgrades, and patching activities in private cloud environments.
  

* Manage and optimize a multi-tier SAP landscape, including workload distribution, automation, and batch management.
  

* Work with and support SAP solutions such as S/4HANA, SAP BTP, Ariba, SAP Cloud ALM, and Signavio.
  

* Lead and perform SAP Basis administration activities, including monitoring, transport management, client administration, and system refreshes.
  

* Ensure system performance, sizing, archiving, and overall platform stability.
  

* Collaborate with internal teams, SAP, and external vendors to support projects and ongoing operations.
  

* Work closely with network and security teams to ensure compliance and secure SAP operations.
  

You report to: Manager Global SAP Applications.

  

While the preferred location for this role is Solna, the position can also be based in one of our mills in Sweden. Frequent travel to our Solna office is an essential part of the role.


**Qualifications**
------------------


* University degree in IT, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  

* Expert knowledge of SAP, particularly SAP S/4HANA.
* Knowledge of SAP RISE.
  

* Solid experience of SAP implementations
  

* Strong experience in SAP Basis administration within ECC and/or S/4HANA environments.
  

* Hands-on experience with SAP HANA database administration, SAP system copy and migration tools, monitoring and performance tuning, and cloud-based SAP environments.
  

* Experience working with SAP BTP administration.
  

* Knowledge of SAP security concepts, including user roles and compliance requirements.
  

* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and practical way.
  

* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
  



Note: You need to have a permanent Swedish work permit in order to be considered for this position.


**Personal qualities**
----------------------



You are committed to delivering high-quality results in both projects and daily operations. With a structured and analytical approach, you are comfortable managing complex technical challenges while maintaining a focus on stability, performance, and continuous improvement.

  



You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working in a global environment where collaboration across teams and functions is an important part of the role.

  



Our values are central to our business, and we believe you recognize yourself in: We care for each other and We do what we say!


**Contact**
-----------



If you have any questions, don't hesitate to reach out to Katarina Kopkin, Senior Manager Global SAP Applications, katarina.kopkin@billerud.com.


**Application information**
---------------------------



Selection and interviews will be held on an ongoing basis. Please apply as soon as possible.

title: Cloud Security Tech Lead
description:
* Ansök senast: 28 augusti 2026
* Stockholm
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

*Vi söker en Cloud Security Tech Lead som vill vara med och forma Handelsbankens molnsäkerhet. Vi har stort fokus på tillgänglighet och säkerhet med strävan mot PaaS och Cloud Native i Azure.*

**Ditt team**  

Du kommer bli del av ett agilt och tvärfunktionellt team som ansvarar för Cloud-plattformen i Azure. Teamet består av säkerhetsingenjörer, utvecklare och supportpersonal som tillsammans arbetar med att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla lösningar i Azure.


Vi samarbetar med andra operativa team inom teknikavdelningen och IT-säkerhetsavdelningen för design, implementation och förvaltning av våra lösningar i Azure. Då vi har högt ställda krav på låg risk och hög säkerhetsnivå är det viktigt att bygga upp ett gott samarbete internt inom IT-säkerhet och compliance.


**Din roll**  

Rollen som Cloud Security Tech Lead är både operativ och strategisk. Du kommer ansvara för design, implementera och vidareutveckla säkerhetslösningar och vara delaktig i vidareutveckling av arkitektur för Azure. Ditt ansvar innefattar att utvärdera och integrera nya säkerhetsteknologier inom bankens infrastruktur.


Du kommer också delta i strategiska beslut som kopplat till bankens moln- och säkerhetsstrategier. Rollen innebär även att du tekniskt kommer vägleda teamet inom säkerhet, och då arbeta nära flera utvecklingsteam för att kontinuerligt integrera säkerhetstänket.


**Vi har riktigt bra förmåner**
-------------------------------

* Tjänstepension
* Resultatandelssystem
* Gruppförsäkring
* Friskvårdsbidrag
* Bidrag vid föräldraledighet
* Banktjänster
* Banking services
* Benefit in connection with parental leave
* Health promotion subsidy
* Group insurance
* Occupational pension
* Profit-sharing scheme
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Din profil**  

Du har omfattande erfarenhet av att arbeta med molnsäkerhet i Azure, och Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Därtill har du kunskap och praktisk erfarenhet inom infrastruktur, Azure Kubernetes och relevanta PaaS-tjänster. Du är tydligt insatt inom säkerhetsprotokoll och -standarder och kan praktiskt omvandla det till tekniska krav.


Du har tidigare ansvarat för att leda säkerhetsarbetet inom närmsta teamet där det är meriterande om du har haft ansvar som säkerhetsarkitekt eller liknande. Vi ser det som meriterande om du har arbetat med andra plattformar on-prem, har Microsoft-certifieringar inom molnsäkerhet, automatisering, IaC, eller JSON.


Då vi samarbetar med hela koncernen behöver du behärska god svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.


Rollen innebär samarbete med flera olika delar av koncernen så vi ser det som viktigt att du kan anpassa din kommunikation beroende på mottagaren. Du inkluderar olika perspektiv och framför samtidigt din åsikt på ett tydligt, inlyssnande och respektfullt sätt. Ditt arbetssätt är lösningsorienterat där du tar dig an problemet med den kompetens som finns i teamet. Samtidigt har du förmåga att fatta självständiga beslut och leda teamet mot ett gemensamt mål.


**Välkommen med din ansökan**

Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.


Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.


**Kontaktuppgifter**

**Rekryterande chef:** Peter Höglund, peter.hoglund@handelsbanken.se
  

**Talent Acquisition Partner:** Henrik Alm, henrik.alm2@handelsbanken.se
  

**Facklig representant Finansförbundet:** Per Almshult, per.almshult@handelsbanken.se
  

**Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen:** Bjarne Nilsson, bjarne.nilsson@handelsbanken.se


  
**Om företaget**
----------------

Hos oss får du ett stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka din egen och bankens framtida utveckling. Våra olika perspektiv, insikter och innovativa idéer utgör en grund för hur vi tillsammans bygger vidare banken för framtiden. För oss är utveckling allt och när du utvecklas, utvecklas banken.


Vi har ett unikt sätt att bedriva bank som bygger på en stark tilltro och respekt för den enskilda människan. Våra värderingar och starka företagskultur har en avgörande betydelse för vår framgång och guidar oss om hur vi uppnår våra mål, samarbetar och stöttar varandra. Genom stark lokal förankring, ett decentraliserat arbetssätt och ett långsiktigt perspektiv skapar vi hållbara relationer genom livets olika skeenden. Hos oss på Handelsbanken är alla viktiga. Vi kommer från olika platser med olika bakgrund, erfarenhet och utbildning. Tillsammans är vi Handelsbanken.

title: Cloud Site Reliability Engineer ﻿
description:
*Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld.*

**Din roll**


Vi söker en Cloud Site Reliability Engineer som vill kombinera mjukvaruutveckling, automatisering och systemdrift för att skapa robusta och skalbara molnplattformar. Här får du arbeta med teknik som är central för våra digitala lösningar och bidra till att våra plattformar är stabila, säkra och tillgängliga över tid.


Som Cloud Site Reliability Engineer blir du en del av Cloud & Infrastructure inom Core Development Platform. Teamet utvecklar och förvaltar gemensamma moln- och IT-plattformstjänster inom Saab Surveillance.


I rollen arbetar du i gränslandet mellan utveckling och drift med fokus på stabilitet, automation och kontinuerliga förbättringar. Du arbetar med våra hybrida molnmiljöer och bidrar till att minska manuellt arbete genom automatisering, samtidigt som du säkerställer hög tillgänglighet, prestanda och säkerhet.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:

* Utveckla, driftsätta och vidareutveckla plattformar baserade på Kubernetes, OpenStack och Ceph
* Automatisera infrastruktur och deployment med Infrastructure as Code och CI/CD
* Utveckla och övervaka robusta och skalbara nätverkslösningar
* Arbeta med incidenthantering, analys, post-mortems och kapacitetsplanering
* Administrera och vidareutveckla Linux-baserade system, exempelvis OpenStack-kontrollplan, worker-noder och Ceph-kluster
* Bidra till observability, monitorering och kontinuerliga förbättringar av plattformens stabilitet och prestanda

**Din profil**


Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering eller liknande roller och som trivs med att arbeta nära både utveckling och drift. Du har en bred teknisk förståelse och är van vid att arbeta med komplexa plattformsmiljöer där automatisering, säkerhet och stabilitet står i fokus.  

  

Du har ett genuint intresse för AI och ny teknik, och drivs av att utforska hur dessa verktyg kan användas för att utveckla både våra lösningar och våra arbetssätt. Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och initiativtagande, tycker om att samarbeta och dela kunskap.


Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:

* Kubernetes, OpenStack och Ceph
* AWS och hybrida molnmiljöer
* Linux och nätverk
* Infrastructure as Code och CI/CD
* Observability och monitorering
* DevSecOps och automatiserad säkerhetsskanning
* Security hardening av infrastruktur och plattformar


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att ta ett tekniskt ledarskap och driva frågor tillsammans med tvärfunktionella team.

*Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.*

### **Vad du blir en del av**


Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.


Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 26,100 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.


Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

title: Senior OpenStack-arkitekt ﻿
description:
*Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld.*

**Din roll**


Vi söker en senior OpenStack-arkitekt som vill vara med och utveckla en säker, robust och skalbar privat molnplattform. Här får du en tekniskt central roll där du arbetar med arkitektur och vidareutveckling av plattformen och är med och formar lösningar för några av Saabs mest avancerade system.


Som OpenStack-arkitekt blir du en del av Cloud & Infrastructure inom Core Development Platform. Teamet utvecklar och förvaltar gemensamma moln- och IT-plattformstjänster för Digital Battlespace Solutions inom Saab Surveillance.


I rollen ansvarar du för att utveckla och vidareutveckla arkitekturen för en privat och offline-kapabel molnplattform. Du arbetar nära utvecklingsteam, drift och säkerhetsfunktioner för att säkerställa en stabil och säker plattform som möter högt ställda krav på tillgänglighet och skalbarhet.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:

* Utforma och vidareutveckla arkitekturen för OpenStack-miljön inom bland annat nätverk, lagring, compute och säkerhet
* Driva tekniskt genomförande av nya funktioner, tjänster och komponenter i plattformen
* Säkerställa att lösningar möter relevanta säkerhetskrav och interna riktlinjer
* Utveckla och förbättra automatisering med exempelvis Ansible, Terraform och Helm
* Analysera och optimera plattformens stabilitet, prestanda och skalbarhet
* Dokumentera arkitektur, designbeslut och tekniska lösningar
* Stötta interna team genom teknisk rådgivning, kunskapsdelning och workshops

**Din profil**


Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av OpenStack och som har arbetat med arkitektur, utveckling eller drift av större och komplexa plattformsmiljöer. Du har ett brett infrastrukturellt perspektiv, känner dig trygg med att fatta tekniska beslut och trivs med att ta initiativ i en komplex miljö.


Du har ett genuint intresse för AI och ny teknik, och drivs av att utforska hur dessa verktyg kan användas för att utveckla både våra lösningar och våra arbetssätt. Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och initiativtagande, tycker om att samarbeta och dela kunskap.


Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:

* OpenStack-arkitektur och drift i större miljöer
* Ceph och distribuerade lagringslösningar
* Kubernetes och containerbaserade miljöer
* Linux, nätverk och infrastruktursäkerhet
* Automatisering och Infrastructure as Code
* Ansible, Terraform, Helm eller motsvarande tekniker


Erfarenhet av privata datacenter, offline-miljöer eller miljöer med höga säkerhetskrav är meriterande.

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

description:
**About Eaton**

Eaton is a global intelligent power management company helping customers manage energy more safely, efficiently and sustainably. Within Eaton's Distributed Power Quality (DPQ) business, Data Centers represent one of our fastest-growing and most strategic markets, driven by cloud computing, digitalization and Artificial Intelligence.


**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

You will own the strategy, roadmap and lifecycle management of Eaton's White Space portfolio across EMEA.


You will identify market opportunities, define product requirements and work closely with Engineering, Marketing, Sales and Operations teams across EMEA and North America to drive profitable growth and innovation in one of Eaton's most strategic segments.

* IT Racks & Accessories
* Rack PDUs

* Strong business and financial acumen.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global matrix organization.
* Fluent English required.

* Join one of Eaton's fastest-growing strategic businesses.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Evolution Innovation
description:
**Company Description**  

Evolution is the world leader in online casino entertainment, serving hundreds of operators and millions of players worldwide. Evolution Innovation is a new department, created to explore what comes next: new products, new technology, new ways of doing things - built at startup speed with the backing of a global, profitable tech company.


We're a small, dedicated team building from Stockholm. Nothing here is someone else's problem: we own our products end-to-end, help each other out and have fun doing it. Meetings are rare, process is lightweight and decisions get made fast - by the people closest to the work. The pace is high because the work is interesting - we ship real products to production, not slide decks.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help build the next generation of products at Evolution Innovation. You'll own features end-to-end - from real-time data systems to polished frontends - and help bring Go into our platform.


Why Evolution Innovation? Evolution is the world leader in online casino entertainment, serving hundreds of operators and millions of players worldwide. Evolution Innovation is a new department, created to explore what comes next: new products, new technology, new ways of doing things - built at startup speed with the backing of a global, profitable tech company.


We're a small, dedicated team building from Stockholm. Nothing here is someone else's problem: we own our products end-to-end, help each other out and have fun doing it. Meetings are rare, process is lightweight and decisions get made fast - by the people closest to the work. The pace is high because the work is interesting - we ship real products to production, not slide decks.

 **Qualifications** **What we're looking for**

* You have 5+ years of experience building software professionally, with real depth in TypeScript/Node.


- You're comfortable across the stack - you can build a React feature and the API behind it without waiting for someone else.

* You have solid SQL and PostgreSQL skills and production experience on AWS.


- Go experience is a strong plus - our platform is TypeScript today and you'll help decide where Go earns its place and build the first services in it.

* You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, scoping your own work and solving problems as they arise.
* You ship fast, care deeply and collaborate without ego.


- You're based in the Stockholm area or ready to relocate - this is an on-site role with flexibility when life needs it.


That said, this is a description, not a checklist. Skills can be taught - drive and raw ability can't - so if you've built things that prove you have both, apply even if you miss a few bullets. We'd rather teach a great engineer our stack than lose one over a missing keyword.

**What you'll do**


In one sentence: build and scale real-time data products end-to-end and shape how a brand-new platform gets engineered.


- Design and ship features across the whole stack - streaming ingest, APIs, data models and the frontends that bring them to life.

* Work with high-throughput, real-time data and the challenges that come with it: performance, reliability and queries that stay fast as data grows.
* Help introduce Go for performance-critical services.


- Own your work in production - architecture, code, deploys and everything in between. All our infrastructure is code.

* Shape the platform's direction: conventions, tooling and architecture decisions are being made now, by the people writing the code.

**Our tech stack**


We pick tools because they're the right ones, not because they're the safe ones. Examples of tech in our stack include:

* Frontend: React and TypeScript.
* Backend:TypeScript (Node, Bun, Hono)


- with Go on the way in. - Data: PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB.

* Cloud: AWS (ECS, Kinesis, RDS), infrastructure defined in CDK.


And always on the lookout for what's next.

 **Additional Information** **Our benefits are**

* Competitive pension, health and medical insurance
* 30 paid vacation days
* Fitness benefit (Friskvårdsbidrag)
* Professional growth
* Sport activities, parties, team buildings

  

**This is a 100% on-site position.** Based in Stockholm, Sweden.

**About your application**


-Please submit your application in English - it's our working language.

* Send your CV or LinkedIn profile; a GitHub link or a note about something you've built is even better.
* We keep the process tight: intro chat, technical deep-dive with the team, meet the department head. No take-home busywork.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Acquisition | Remote | Sweden
description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.



We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.



You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.



### **The Opportunity**


Grafana Labs is looking for an **Enterprise Account Executive, Acquisition** based in Sweden who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across the **Nordics**. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.
### **What You’ll Be Doing**


* Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals
* Outbound prospecting into net-new customers
* Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations)
* Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads
* Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise
* Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce
* Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

### **What Makes You a Great Fit:**


* 5+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales
* Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)
* Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player
* Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
* You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
* Fluent in English and Swedish (both written and spoken)

 ### **Bonus Points For:**


* Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
* Experience using Salesforce
* Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal
* Fluency in Danish and/or Norwegian (both written and spoken)
### **Compensation & Rewards**


In Sweden, the OTE compensation range for this role is SEK 2,016,000 - SEK 2,546,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

* *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.*


**Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:**


* **100% Remote, Global Culture -** As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* **Innovation-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* **Open Source Roots** – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* **In-Person onboarding** - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* **Balance is Key** - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.*


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*


*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*



#LI-Remote



*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our* *privacy policy**.*

title: Business Development Representative Team Lead
description:

Xensam is the leader in AI-powered, cloud-based Software Asset Management. Our technology brings clarity to complex IT environments, helping users make smart, data-driven decisions and maximize software ROI.


Recognized with the Highest Growth Award and ranked #3 Overall Champion at the Main Software 50 Awards Nordics, we’re scaling fast and looking for people who want to join the journey. At Xensam, you play a key role in a team built on energy, focus, and positivity. We value experience, but even more, the person behind it.


Together, we build the future of SAM.

 **About the role**


We are looking for a Business Development Representative Team Lead to coach, guide, and support our BDR team while continuing to contribute directly to pipeline growth.


This is a hands-on team lead role without formal personnel responsibility. You will support a team of up to six Business Development Representatives through regular 1:1s, coaching, development support, and day-to-day guidance. Alongside leading the team, you will maintain a reduced individual quota and stay close to the work through both inbound and outbound sales activities.


You will work closely with the Director of Business Development, Account Management, and Marketing to strengthen team performance and create high-quality opportunities that contribute to Xensam's growth.

* Drive team performance, motivation, and accountability while supporting recruitment and onboarding
* Maintain a reduced individual quota and contribute directly to pipeline generation
* Drive inbound and outbound prospecting to generate qualified meetings and opportunities
* Qualify leads and ensure effective handovers to Account Managers
* Maintain high standards for outreach, lead follow-up, and CRM accuracy
* Share market, prospect, and competitor insights to improve our GTM approach
* Collaborate with Sales and Marketing on targeting, messaging, campaigns, and outreach

* 3+ years experience in a Senior Business Development, Senior Sales Development, or a similar B2B Saas environment.
* Experience coaching, mentoring, or supporting the development of sales representatives
* Strong understanding of prospecting, lead qualification, and inbound and outbound sales
* Strong communication, active listening, and relationship-building skills
* Experience with sales tools such as HubSpot, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or ZoomInfo

title: Cloud Security Tech Lead till Handelsbanken
description:
*Vi söker en Cloud Security Tech Lead som vill vara med och forma Handelsbankens molnsäkerhet. Vi har stort fokus på tillgänglighet och säkerhet med strävan mot PaaS och Cloud Native i Azure.*
**Ditt team** 
 Du kommer bli del av ett agilt och tvärfunktionellt team som ansvarar för Cloud-plattformen i Azure. Teamet består av säkerhetsingenjörer, utvecklare och supportpersonal som tillsammans arbetar med att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla lösningar i Azure.
   

  

 Vi samarbetar med andra operativa team inom teknikavdelningen och IT-säkerhetsavdelningen för design, implementation och förvaltning av våra lösningar i Azure. Då vi har högt ställda krav på låg risk och hög säkerhetsnivå är det viktigt att bygga upp ett gott samarbete internt inom IT-säkerhet och compliance.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Rollen som Cloud Security Tech Lead är både operativ och strategisk. Du kommer ansvara för design, implementera och vidareutveckla säkerhetslösningar och vara delaktig i vidareutveckling av arkitektur för Azure. Ditt ansvar innefattar att utvärdera och integrera nya säkerhetsteknologier inom bankens infrastruktur.
   

  

 Du kommer också delta i strategiska beslut som kopplat till bankens moln- och säkerhetsstrategier. Rollen innebär även att du tekniskt kommer vägleda teamet inom säkerhet, och då arbeta nära flera utvecklingsteam för att kontinuerligt integrera säkerhetstänket.
   

  

**Din profil**
 Du har omfattande erfarenhet av att arbeta med molnsäkerhet i Azure, och Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Därtill har du kunskap och praktisk erfarenhet inom infrastruktur, Azure Kubernetes och relevanta PaaS-tjänster. Du är tydligt insatt inom säkerhetsprotokoll och -standarder och kan praktiskt omvandla det till tekniska krav.
   

  

 Du har tidigare ansvarat för att leda säkerhetsarbetet inom närmsta teamet där det är meriterande om du har haft ansvar som säkerhetsarkitekt eller liknande. Vi ser det som meriterande om du har arbetat med andra plattformar on-prem, har Microsoft-certifieringar inom molnsäkerhet, automatisering, IaC, eller JSON.
   

  

 Då vi samarbetar med hela koncernen behöver du behärska god svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.

title: Operations Center Engineer
description:
Join Dustin’s Operations Center and take on a pivotal role at the heart of our Managed Services organization, where you’ll proactively monitor customer environments, manage critical incidents, and help ensure business continuity around the clock. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and want to make a real impact while growing your technical expertise, this is the opportunity for you.
   

  

 This position is available in either our Nacka Strand (Stockholm) or Malmö office, offering the opportunity to join a highly skilled team from one of our key locations in Sweden.
   

  

**This is what makes the position as Operations Center Engineer unique**
* Be at the heart of the action in a business-critical role that helps safeguard customer operations around the clock
* Join a highly collaborative team where knowledge sharing, and continuous development are part of everyday work
* Build broad technical experience across infrastructure, networking, monitoring, and Managed Services while working with a diverse customer landscape


 My name is Josefin Landgren, and I am the Manager for Operations Center and Incident Management at Dustin. As a leader, I strive to create an inclusive and engaging environment where every team member feels valued, has the opportunity to grow professionally, and is empowered to shape their own career path. My goal is to support you with continuous learning, collaboration, and trust, so that together we can deliver great results while enjoying the journey.
   

  

**Your role & influence as Operations Center Engineer**
*Responsibility* 
 : You are responsible for maintaining operational oversight of customer environments and ensuring incidents, alerts, and service requests are handled efficiently and according to established processes. Through your contribution, customers can rely on stable and well-managed IT services.
   

  

*Collaboration* 
 : Together with your team you will ensure seamless service delivery, to resolve customer issues effectively and contribute to continuous service improvements. You'll work closely not only with your immediate team members but also with cross-functional Managed Services teams across Dustin.
   

  

*Core activities* 
 :
   

  

* Monitor infrastructure and network environments connected to our customers Managed Services, proactively handling alerts and ensuring stability, performance, and reliability
* Manage incidents and service requests from start to resolution, acting as a key point of contact and providing clear communication throughout the process
* Perform proactive maintenance and operational tasks for Managed Services, while collaborating with internal teams to continuously improve service delivery and customer experience


**This Is What We Imagine You Bring**
 We envision you as a curious and service-minded professional who enjoys troubleshooting, collaborating with others, and working in an environment where priorities can change quickly. You take ownership of your responsibilities and approach challenges with a structured and proactive mindset.
   

  

*Additionally, it's important that:*
* You have a bachelor's degree level of working and thinking
* You have experience supporting customer IT environments in an operations, support, or Managed Services setting
* You have knowledge of infrastructure and networking concepts, with experience of LogicMonitor and Microsoft Managed Services considered an advantage
* You communicate clearly and work effectively with both colleagues and customers


**What can you expect next?**
 To ensure a fair recruitment process free from unconscious bias, we handle your application anonymously and do not accept cover letters. Please refrain from sending one, so that the selection is based solely on professional competencies. We expect the following steps in the recruitment process:
   

  

* 1st interview with manager Josefin Landgren
* Assessment (Personality- and cognitive thinking test)
* 2nd interview with Josefin and a member of the team


*The Hiring Manager Josefin, values transparency and open communication, and will ensure dedicated time during the First Interview to address your questions, fostering a strong mutual fit.*

title: Identity & Access Management Architect
description:
Stockholm, Göteborg or Malmö, Sweden

**The role**
 You'll shape how large organisations design and run identity and access, owning the target architecture and the roadmap to reach it, and advising the security and technology leaders who depend on it. You'll weigh the trade-offs, lead the design across a programme, and guide the team building it. It's a client-facing role that combines the credibility to make the technical calls with the judgement to keep them tied to what the business actually needs. Increasingly that means helping clients adopt AI securely. As AI expands the range of identities that need governing — including machine and non-human ones — the quality of the foundational architecture matters more, not less. You'll work across sectors, bringing design thinking into organisations at different stages of that journey, building the kind of trusted relationships that clients come back to.
   

  

**About Accenture Cybersecurity**
 At Accenture Cybersecurity, we help organisations protect what matters most by combining deep security expertise with leading technology. We support our clients across the entire security journey, from strategy and advisory to implementation and managed security services, helping them navigate an increasingly complex threat landscape with confidence.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
- Own the target-state identity architecture for a client and the roadmap that gets them there, sequencing the work and defending the trade-offs.

- Advise senior client stakeholders, translating what the business needs into an identity solution they can commit to and that will stand up over time.

- Lead the design across a programme and guide the people delivering it.

- Identify the patterns and integration challenges that will shape whether the programme succeeds in practice, and help the team navigate them.

- Help shape new work, bringing design credibility into proposals as well as delivery.

**What We're Looking For**

You can reason about how to build a capability an organisation can actually adopt, not just deploy or maintain a single product such as SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, Ping or Microsoft Entra ID.

- Comfort across both the functional and technical sides of identity, and the stakeholder skill to lead a client conversation at the level of security and technology leadership.

- A solid grasp of software architecture, integration patterns, and application onboarding, and how they shape an identity design.

- Enough breadth in adjacent disciplines — cloud, enterprise integration, directory services — to design a solution that actually fits the client's technical context.

- Around 6+ years of relevant experience.

- Fluent Swedish and English.

- Based in Stockholm, Göteborg or Malmö, on a hybrid pattern.

 Stockholm, Göteborg or Malmö

 A place to grow and learn, on work that carries real weight. title: Network Specialist
description:
*Do you enjoy finding smarter ways to improve network solutions while balancing technical performance, customer needs, and business value? As a Network Specialist at GlobalConnect, you will identify and drive improvements across customer network solutions – from optimization and service improvement to migrations and modernization.*
 You will combine your network expertise with analytical and commercial thinking to turn complex challenges into practical recommendations and measurable improvements.
   

  

**What You Need To Succeed**
* Strong understanding of network services, telecommunications infrastructure, and how network solutions are designed, delivered, and operated.
* Experience working with telecom services, network infrastructure, or customer network solutions.
* Experience analyzing technical solutions and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Ability to evaluate technical solutions from both operational and commercial perspectives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.


**About The Role And The Team**
 You will be part of the Line Management team and work across a broad network of internal and external stakeholders. Internally, you will collaborate with colleagues across areas such as Product Management, Service Delivery, Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Procurement, and Network Engineering.
   

  

 Your focus will be on creating long-term value by improving customer solutions, network services, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness. You will identify opportunities, develop recommendations, and drive improvements within your area of responsibility.
   

  

 You will also contribute to migration, transformation, and network modernization initiatives, helping ensure that technical decisions support both customer needs and GlobalConnect’s business objectives.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Working On**
* Analyze existing customer network solutions and identify technical and commercial optimization opportunities.
* Drive improvements that strengthen service performance, robustness, customer value, and cost efficiency.
* Evaluate network services, infrastructure, and service delivery models and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Develop and support business cases based on technical analysis, commercial considerations, risks, and opportunities.
* Drive or contribute to customer migrations, service transformations, and network modernization initiatives, including technical feasibility and risk assessments.
* Coordinate with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to support successful implementation and value realization.
* Contribute to the development of methods, tools, and best practices that improve how we optimize and manage network services.


**Who We Are Looking For**
 You take ownership of your work and enjoy solving complex problems where the right solution is not always immediately clear. You are curious about how network solutions are built and operated, but also interested in understanding the customer and business context behind them.
   

  

 You are able to balance technical, operational, commercial, and customer considerations and turn your analysis into clear recommendations and practical actions. You are comfortable working independently while collaborating across several functions and stakeholder groups.
   

  

 You communicate clearly and are able to explain complex technical matters in a way that supports business decisions. You are motivated by finding opportunities, challenging existing ways of working, and turning ideas into measurable improvements.
   

  

 Experience with service delivery and lifecycle management, or participation in service transformation and migration activities, is beneficial. A relevant degree in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience is also an advantage.
   

  

**Does this sound like you?**
 If you are looking for an opportunity where you can combine network expertise with business-oriented problem-solving and make a measurable impact on customer value, service performance, operational efficiency, and network transformation, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
* Talent Acquisition Screening Interview
* Interview with Hiring Manager and Peer
* Personality and ability tests, followed by feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition
* Final alignment meeting
* References


**Practical information**
* GlobalConnect’s standard setup is at least three days per week in the office.
* GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship.


 No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.
   

  

**About Us**
 GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.
   

  

 We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

title: ProServe Area Delivery Leader, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is looking for an experienced ProServe Area Delivery Leader (PADL) to join our Shared Delivery Team (SDT). This senior leadership role is responsible for all delivery activities within the Area (single/multi-country or Practice/Industry), ensuring optimal support while maximizing team utilization and revenue performance. You'll report to the Geo Delivery Leader serving as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal AWS teams.
   

  

 As PADLs you will coach, manage, and guide Delivery Practice Managers (DPMs) and their teams, to ensure they are providing best in class solutions for customers and partners. Routinely engaging with C-level executives within our customers, you will be responsible for ensuring Area SDTs work closely with partner teams; drive business development initiatives through thought leadership; provide portfolio guidance and oversight; and meet and exceed customer satisfaction targets. PADLs primarily drive their teams to partner with ProServe Account Executives to identify, understand, and define business outcomes for customers by building trust, identifying applicable AWS Professional Services offerings, and successfully executing SOWs.
   

  

 Your experience gained leading teams within the technology sector, will equip you with the ability to optimize team growth and performance through implementing tailored people development plans, ensuring Area SDTs are aligned to customer needs, and have the skills and capacity to address customer outcomes. Possessing the ability to translate technical concepts into business value for customers and then talk in technical depth with teams, you will cultivate strong customer, Amazon Global Sales (AGS), and ProServe team relationships which enables exceptional business performance. PADLs success is primarily measured through the Area P&L by delivering customer engagements on time, within budget, and exceeding customer expectations (CSAT).
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Leading and managing the Area Shared Delivery Team, overseeing Delivery Practice Managers (DPMs) and their teams
* Ensuring delivery of best-in-class solutions for customers and partners, meeting and exceeding satisfaction targets
* Driving business development initiatives and provide portfolio guidance and oversight
* Collaborating with ProServe Account Executives to identify and define customer business outcomes
* Managing the Area P&L, optimizing team growth, performance, and utilization
* Serving as an escalation point for Sales and Delivery teams, engaging in pre-sales, in-flight projects, and post-implementation reviews

 Diverse Experiences

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work-life harmony.
   

  

 Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

* Experience leading cloud transformation projects
*

 Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. title: IT-säkerhetsarkitekt
description:
Vill du ta ett helhetsansvar för säkerhetsarkitekturen hos ett bolag vars tjänster måste fungera när det verkligen gäller? Då kan det vara dig vi söker i rollen som IT-säkerhetsarkitekt till Teracom.
   

  

 Teracom ser till att radio, tv och beredskapskommunikation når fram när det verkligen gäller, oavsett om det råder solsken, storm eller kris. Som statligt bolag med över 100 års erfarenhet av samhällsviktig infrastruktur bygger och moderniserar vi den infrastruktur som Sverige är beroende av för att fungera i alla lägen. I den här rollen är du med och driver den fortsatta moderniseringen.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 I rollen som IT-säkerhetsarkitekt tar du ett övergripande ansvar för att etablera och vidareutveckla säkerhetsarkitekturen för Teracoms digitala lösningar. Du har en central roll i att säkerställa att säkerhet integreras tidigt i utvecklings- och förändringsinitiativ och att säkerhetskrav omsätts till lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.
   

  

 Du samarbetar nära arkitekter, utvecklings- och driftteam och arbetar tätt ihop med IT-säkerhetschefen och CISO. Du deltar även i leverantörsbedömningar och upphandlingar och har löpande dialog med Teracoms SOC.
   

  

 I takt med Teracoms fortsatta modernisering ställs nya krav på säkerhetsarbetet, inte minst kopplat till AI där frågor om var verktyg får användas och vad som får lagras var är högst aktuella. Rollen innebär ett stort mandat att påverka hur säkerhet byggs in i framtida lösningar och arbetssätt.
   

  

 Mer om dig
   

  

 För att trivas i rollen är du analytisk, lösningsorienterad och har förmågan att se helheten i komplexa tekniska miljöer. Du är pragmatisk i ditt arbetssätt och trivs med att omsätta säkerhetskrav till lösningar som fungerar i verkligheten. Samtidigt är du kommunikativ och van att samarbeta med både tekniska och verksamhetsnära intressenter.
   

  

 Vi tror att du har:
   

  

* Flera års erfarenhet som säkerhetsarkitekt eller från en senior IT-säkerhetsroll.
* Stark teknisk kompetens inom IT-säkerhet, nätverkssäkerhet, identitetshantering och molnsäkerhet.
* Erfarenhet av hotmodellering, riskanalys och säkerhetsgranskning i komplexa IT-miljöer
* Erfarenhet av moderna säkerhetsverktyg och plattformar inom områden som IAM, SIEM, EDR, sårbarhetshantering samt DevSecOps (t.ex. SAST och SCA).
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta nära utvecklings- och driftteam i praktiska säkerhetsfrågor.
* God förståelse för regulatoriska krav inom säkerhet och integritet.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från samhällsviktig eller säkerhetsklassad verksamhet. Erfarenhet av säkerhetsarkitektur kopplad till AI- eller dataplattformar är också värdefullt, liksom erfarenhet av säkerhetsarbete enligt etablerade standarder och ramverk. Bakgrund inom utveckling, penetrationstestning, säkerhetsengineering eller DevSecOps samt certifieringar såsom CISSP, CCSP, SABSA eller OSCP är också meriterande.
   

  

 Teracom erbjuder
   

  

 Du får marknadsmässiga villkor och goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll. Förmåner inkluderar:
   

  

* Friskvårdsbidrag
* Rikskort eller subventionerat SL-kort
* Arbetstidsförkortning
* 2 friskvårdstimmar/vecka


 Mer information finns på Teracoms hemsida.
   

  

 Bra att känna till
   

  

 För anställning krävs godkänd drog- och alkoholtest samt att godkänd bakgrundskontroll liksom godkänd säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll genomförs. Detta eftersom anställningen innefattar säkerhetsklassning. Med anledning av detta krävs svenskt alternativt nordiskt medborgarskap.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Låter det här som en roll för dig? Då vill vi gärna höra ifrån dig. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande så tveka inte på att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. För frågor, kontakta Sara Åkerlund, sara.akerlund@ants.se.
   

  

 Om du inte redan känner Teracom
   

  

 Teracom samhällsnät bidrar till ett tryggare samhälle genom att våra tjänster ser till att information och kommunikation kan fungera för de allra viktigaste samhällsfunktionerna även i kris och krig. Våra uppdrag inkluderar utsändningen av public servicekanalerna för radio och tv, kommunikationslösningar och beredskapsuppdraget. Vi utvecklar och levererar också allt fler beredskapstjänster samt olika typer av kommunikationslösningar till totalförsvarsviktiga aktörer. Vi är ett statligt bolag med cirka 500 medarbetare på ett 50-tal orter i Sverige. Vår vision är att, tillsammans med våra uppdragsgivare, göra Sverige tryggare där det behövs, när det behövs.

 I rollen förväntas du arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du aktivt använder teamet för att höja kvaliteten i leveransen. Du bygger förtroende i dialogen med kund genom att vara tydlig, pedagogisk och trygg, även när du behöver utmana eller sätta ramar.
 



  





 Det innebär att du:
 


* prioriterar utifrån kundnytta, risk och leverans och driver arbetet framåt utan detaljstyrning
* hanterar förväntningar transparent och förklarar vad som behöver göras och varför
* tar initiativ till förbättringar och känner ägandeskap för resultatet, även i mindre uppgifter

* bidrar till kunskapsdelning och en gemensamt stark leverans



  





**Vad du behöver ha på plats** 




 Du behöver ha:
 


* cirka 3–5 års erfarenhet inom IT kopplat till Digital eller Modern Workplace
* erfarenhet av Microsoft Intune
* erfarenhet av klient och operativsystem i enterprise eller kundmiljö, exempelvis iOS och Android
* erfarenhet av Entra ID kopplat till identitet, klienter eller åtkomst
* grundläggande förståelse för Endpoint Security och Defender for Endpoint eller motsvarande säkerhetslösning

* vana att arbeta kundnära och omsätta behov till tekniska rekommendationer
* svenska och engelska på god arbetsnivå
* svenskt medborgarskap samt möjlighet till säkerhetsprövning



  





 Meriterande:
 


* Autopilot
* PowerShell, exempelvis att kunna läsa och justera script
* erfarenhet från större eller mer komplexa IT miljöer
* erfarenhet från konsultativ leverans eller Managed Services
* Microsoft certifieringar inom Modern Workplace eller Endpoint, till exempel MD 102 eller MS 102
* erfarenhet av Quest migration tool



  





**Varför du ska välja Advania** 




 Du får en tydlig onboarding kopplad till faktiska kundmiljöer, tekniska områden och aktuella leveranser. Rollen passar dig som vill utvecklas i skärningspunkten mellan teknik, rådgivning och förbättringsarbete. Här finns möjlighet att fördjupa dig inom exempelvis Autopilot, PowerShell och säkerhet samtidigt som du tar ett växande ansvar i både leverans och kunddialog.
 



  





 Hos oss blir du också en del av ett team där tekniskt hantverk inte bara handlar om att lösa problem själv, utan om att göra varandra bättre. Vi delar lösningar, lärdomar och resonemang, jämför vägval och använder dialogen för att höja kvaliteten i det vi levererar. När alla tar ansvar finns också utrymme för arbetsglädje, nyfikenhet och relationer som gör oss starkare tillsammans. Det här är en roll för dig som vill bidra med både teknisk kompetens och sättet du samarbetar på – där din förmåga att skapa dialog, dela kunskap och inspirera till nya lösningar blir en viktig del av både kundvärdet och teamets utveckling.
 



  





 Vi ser emot din ansökan! 👋
